battle.name: 英國伊拉克戰爭
battle.brief: 英國伊拉克戰爭是中文維基戰爭列表所列衝突，1941年4月至5月由英國發動並迅速取得控制。此前的英國獨立伊拉克已因石油利益與德義關係而分裂。戰役主要涉及伊拉克全境，以及巴格達、基爾庫克等城鎮。英軍裝備線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun），用於野戰砲兵與早期步兵支援。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛砲（Muzzle-loading field gun）屬於野戰砲兵與步兵支援火砲，採前裝式設計，以火藥推動彈丸攻擊地面目標。它是十九世紀野戰砲兵體系中的常見重火力裝備，並非本世紀才出現的型號。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰核心是英王國與伊拉克王國。英方兵力不是單一英國部隊，而是由巴勒斯坦、外約旦、英屬印度等地的既有陸空部隊、補充兵與海運編組拼成；駐外約旦的阿拉伯軍團是最重要的地面夥伴之一。科威特由英國提供防禦承諾，是伊拉克首先越境攻擊的目標。德國與義大利向伊拉克提供顧問與軍援，德國另派航空任務和飛行人員；伊朗在戰爭中保持中立，但部分伊拉克軍政單位沿底格里斯河向伊朗方向撤退。
countriesEn: The principal belligerents were the United Kingdom and the Kingdom of Iraq. The British force was not a single British formation: it was assembled from existing land and air units, reinforcements, and maritime transport drawn from Palestine, Transjordan, British India, and elsewhere. The Arab Legion based in Transjordan was one of its most important ground partners. Britain had given Kuwait a defence commitment, and Kuwait was the first target of the Iraqi invasion. Germany and Italy supplied advisers and military matériel to Iraq, while Germany additionally provided an air mission and pilots. Iran remained neutral during the war, although some Iraqi military and government units withdrew in the Iranian direction.
people: 英國方面，首相溫斯頓·邱吉爾決定施以軍事反制；中東戰區最高指揮由陸軍元帥阿奇博爾德·韋維爾負責，愛德華·基南中將則以第一軍團及伊拉克特遣部隊指揮官的身體具體統率攻勢。艾倫·坎寧安·威爾森少將率第一步兵旅防守哈巴尼亞，羅伯特·邁爾斯少將率第二步兵旅接應，羅伯特·格盧布少將指揮阿拉伯軍團在北線作戰。伊拉克方面，費薩爾二世仍是名義君主；努里·賽義德在四月初被親德的新政府取代，拉希德·阿里·蓋拉尼出任首相，薩爾曼·哈巴希少將則率領最初進攻科威特的部隊。
peopleEn: On the British side, Prime Minister Winston Churchill decided upon military retaliation. Field Marshal Archibald Wavell held overall command in the Middle East theatre, while Lieutenant-General Sir Edward Quinan commanded the I Corps and the British Iraq Force in operational terms. Brigadier Alan Cunningham Wilson led the 1st Infantry Brigade in the defence of Habbaniya, Brigadier Robert Miles brought the 2nd Infantry Brigade into the battle, and Brigadier Robert Glubb commanded the Arab Legion on the northern front. On the Iraqi side, Faisal II remained the nominal monarch. Nuri al-Said was replaced at the beginning of April by a German-oriented government, with Rashid Ali al-Gaylani becoming prime minister. Brigadier General Salman al-Habashi commanded the force that initially invaded Kuwait.
kits: 英軍步兵以李-恩菲爾德 No. 4步槍、勃倫輕機槍、2英吋迫擊砲、25磅野戰砲、18磅野戰砲、4.5英吋榴彈砲、3.7英吋反戰車砲及Boys反戰車槍構成主要火力；裝甲包括輕型坦克 Mk VI、AEC裝甲車與戴姆勒偵察車。英軍航空隊使用布里斯托爾布萊恩、威靈頓、Bristol Bolo、颶風式與格洛斯特格萊迪厄，分別執行轟炸、偵察、戰鬥及近地支援。伊拉克軍同樣大量使用英制或仿英制裝備，包括Vickers Light Tank Mk VI、Vickers K重機槍、英制野戰砲與迫擊砲，以及Hurricane Mk I、Gloster Gladiator和Bristol Blenheim；少量德製Messerschmitt Bf 109 E亦加入作戰。英軍靠海法經外約旦向前線輸送.303步槍彈藥、25磅砲的爆破與反裝甲彈藥，以及輕型坦克使用的2磅砲彈。
kitsEn: British infantry firepower rested on Lee-Enfield No. 4 rifles, Bren light machine guns, 2-inch mortars, 25-pounder field guns, 18-pounder field guns, 4.5-inch howitzers, 3.7-inch anti-tank guns, and Boys anti-tank rifles. Their armoured force included Light Tank Mk VI, AEC armoured cars, and Daimler scout cars. The British air forces used Bristol Blenheims, Wellingtons, Bristol Bolos, Hurricanes, and Gloster Gladiators for bombing, reconnaissance, fighting, and close support. The Iraqi Army likewise relied heavily on British or British-pattern equipment, including Vickers Light Tank Mk VI, Vickers K machine guns, British-pattern field and mortar artillery, and Hurricane Mk I, Gloster Gladiator, and Bristol Blenheim aircraft. A small number of German Messerschmitt Bf 109 E fighters also saw service. Britain sustained the advance by shipping .303 rifle ammunition, high-explosive and anti-armour rounds for 25-pounders, and 2-pounder ammunition for its light tanks through Haifa and Transjordan.
tactics: 英軍把空中偵察、對地火力與地面機動作戰結合，先由皇家空軍打擊伊拉克邊境陣地、空軍基地與補給點，再以F行動在科威特方向製造進攻示動，使伊拉克指揮部把主要注意力放在南方。哈巴尼亞防禦中，第一步兵旅以步兵外圍、25磅砲陣地、3.7英吋反戰車砲及空軍近距支援攔截伊拉克裝甲與步兵反攻；第二步兵旅及第七機動旅抵達後，英軍才沿通往巴格達的公路向東推進。主力攻勢中，步兵旅先固定道路兩側陣地，輕型坦克與裝甲車再超越前衛，砲兵則集中射擊已標定的伊拉克陣位；這種分隊推進仰賴長距離車運、沿途維修及不間斷的油料與彈藥補給。伊拉克軍初期嘗試以步兵、騎兵、坦克及航空兵力實施集中反擊，但各單位協同與補給不足，守線被突破後多沿底格里斯河向東退卻，留下游擊與後衛阻延追兵。五月三十一日，英軍以空降分隊奪取哈巴尼亞機場；北線則由英軍縱隊與阿拉伯軍團共同限制伊拉克軍向摩蘇爾推進。
tacticsEn: British operations combined aerial reconnaissance, firepower, and ground movement. The Royal Air Force first struck Iraqi border positions, airfields, and supply points, while Operation F created a false threat towards Kuwait and drew Iraqi attention away from the main axis. During the defence of Habbaniya, the 1st Infantry Brigade used an infantry perimeter, 25-pounder batteries, 3.7-inch anti-tank guns, and close air support against Iraqi armour and infantry counterattacks. Only after the 2nd Infantry Brigade and 7th Motor Brigade arrived did the British advance east along the road to Baghdad. During the main offensive, infantry brigades secured both sides of the road, light tanks and armoured cars passed the leading troops, and artillery concentrated on registered Iraqi positions. This dispersed advance depended on long-distance motor transport, roadside maintenance, and a continuous flow of fuel and ammunition. Iraq initially attempted concentrated counterattacks with infantry, cavalry, tanks, and aircraft, but coordination and supply were inadequate. Once its defensive lines were broken, most Iraqi formations withdrew east along the Tigris while rear guards delayed the pursuit. On 31 May, a British airborne detachment seized Habbaniya airfield. In the north, British columns and the Arab Legion together restricted Iraqi movements towards Mosul.
data: 1941年4月2日，伊拉克軍在薩爾曼·哈巴希少將率領下越過科威特北部邊界，進攻英國保護的科威特；英軍與科威特部隊藉空軍支援和邊境反擊，迫使第一波伊拉克進攻退回邊境一側。4月3日，拉希德·阿里取代努里·賽義德出任首相。伊拉克的攻勢不只限於科威特：四月下旬，北線部隊向基爾庫克與摩蘇爾方向推進，英軍縱隊、阿拉伯軍團和皇家空軍在該區形成牽制；德國軍事顧問、軍械與Bf 109 E進入伊拉克，使原本的邊界衝突迅速擴成全面戰爭。五月二日，英軍從海法經外約旦向伊拉克境內發動大規模空襲，並在科威特方向實施F行動，配合地面部隊展開。五月五日，威爾森的第一步兵旅進入距巴格達約八十公里的哈巴尼亞，占據城區、供水點與外圍陣地；由海法運來的補給車隊則把25磅砲彈藥、.303步槍彈藥、燃料與糧食送入陣地。五月十日至十二日，伊拉克第一梯隊、騎兵與裝甲部隊向哈巴尼亞反攻，英軍以25磅砲、Boys反戰車槍、輕型坦克及皇家空軍的近地攻擊阻止其突破，第二步兵旅亦在此期間抵達陣地。五月十四日，英軍航空隊以Bristol Bolo攻擊哈巴尼亞，擊毀或擊傷停在機場的伊拉克飛機；其後數日，英軍持續以空襲削弱前線裝甲，同時把坦克、砲兵與補給向前展開。五月十八日，第一、第二步兵旅和第七機動旅等部發動主攻，步兵沿道路兩側逐段奪取陣地，輕型坦克與裝甲車則從缺口超越推進；伊拉克防線在西巴格達方向逐步崩解。五月二十三日，英軍裝甲車與機動步兵進入巴格達，伊拉克政府人員與野戰指揮部則向底格里斯河以東撤退。五月下旬至月底，英軍在巴庫巴、傑貝爾哈姆扎等地追擊伊拉克後衛，迫使其餘師旅繼續東撤；北線的阿拉伯軍團與英軍縱隊也由基爾庫克方向推進，逼近摩蘇爾的外圍道路。五月三十一日，一支英軍空降分隊控制哈巴尼亞機場，摧毀仍在場上的伊拉克航空器與附屬設備，使英軍取得完整的空運與維修節點。六月二日，伊拉克軍政代表在哈巴尼亞接受英方提出的停戰條件；北線伊拉克部隊也依同一安排停止抵抗，戰役以英軍控制巴格達、哈巴尼亞及北方主要交通線的結果結束。
dataEn: On 2 April 1941, Iraqi troops under Brigadier General Salman al-Habashi crossed the northern Kuwaiti frontier and attacked the British-protected territory. British and Kuwaiti forces used air support and counterattacks on the frontier to push the first Iraqi incursion back across the border. On 3 April, Rashid Ali replaced Nuri al-Said as prime minister. Iraqi operations were not confined to Kuwait: in late April, troops in the northern theatre advanced towards Kirkuk and Mosul, where British columns, the Arab Legion, and the Royal Air Force formed a containing force. German military advisers, weapons, and Bf 109 E fighters entered Iraq, turning the border conflict into a general war. On 2 May, the British launched large-scale air attacks from staging areas reached through Haifa and Transjordan, conducted Operation F towards Kuwait, and began their ground offensive. On 5 May, Wilson's 1st Infantry Brigade entered Habbaniya, roughly eighty kilometres west of Baghdad, occupied the town, secured water points, and established an outer perimeter. Motor transport from Haifa continued bringing forward 25-pounder ammunition, .303 rifle ammunition, fuel, and rations. From 10 to 12 May, Iraqi infantry formations, cavalry, and armour counterattacked Habbaniya. The British checked the attack with 25-pounders, Boys anti-tank rifles, light tanks, and close air support, while the 2nd Infantry Brigade arrived during the same period. On 14 May, British aircraft attacked the airfield at Habbaniya with Bristol Bolos, damaging or destroying Iraqi aircraft parked there. During the following days, continued air attacks weakened the Iraqi armoured formations forward while British tanks, artillery, and supplies moved closer to the front. On 18 May, the 1st and 2nd Infantry Brigades, the 7th Motor Brigade, and other units launched the main offensive. Infantry seized positions successively along both sides of the road, while light tanks and armoured cars passed through gaps and continued the advance. The Iraqi defensive system west of Baghdad progressively disintegrated. On 23 May, British armoured cars and motorized infantry entered Baghdad, while Iraqi government personnel and field headquarters withdrew east across the Tigris. From late May until the end of the month, the British pursued Iraqi rearguards around Baqubah and Jebel Hamza, forcing the remaining divisions farther east. In the north, the Arab Legion and British columns also advanced from the Kirkuk direction towards the main roads outside Mosul. On 31 May, a British airborne detachment took control of Habbaniya airfield, destroyed Iraqi aircraft still present and their supporting equipment, and gave the British a usable air-transport and maintenance base. On 2 June, Iraqi military and political representatives accepted British ceasefire terms at Habbaniya. Iraqi formations in the north ceased resistance under the same arrangement, ending the campaign with British control of Baghdad, Habbaniya, and the principal northern communications routes.
cause: 遠因是1936年英伊條約及英軍在伊拉克的駐紮權，使伊拉克軍方強烈派長期不滿；四〇年代德國影響進入伊拉克政治與軍隊，親德的武裝軍官因而掌握更多資源。直接原因則是1941年4月的政變、拉希德·阿里政府的成立，以及伊拉克軍對科威特和北方英軍據點的攻擊。德國顧問、軍火與航空支援使英國懷疑伊拉克會成為德國在波斯灣的據點，而科威特、外約旦、巴勒斯坦、蘇伊士航路及伊拉克石油利益又構成英方不能退讓的戰略理由。英國最初以空軍報復和有限地面進攻回應，隨著伊拉克攻勢擴大，遂把目標擴大為驅逐軸心國軍事任務、解除伊拉克對科威特的威脅、恢復英國影響，並迫使親德內閣下台。
causeEn: The deeper causes included the 1936 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty and the continued presence of British troops in Iraq, both of which were strongly resented by Iraqi army officers. During the 1940s, German influence entered Iraqi politics and the armed forces, giving the pro-German faction access to greater resources. The immediate causes were the April 1941 change of government, the installation of Rashid Ali's administration, and Iraqi attacks against Kuwait and British positions in the north. German advisers, weapons, and air support led Britain to fear that Iraq would become a German foothold in the Persian Gulf, while Kuwait, Transjordan, Palestine, the Suez route, and Iraqi oil interests created strategic commitments that Britain could not abandon. Britain initially responded with air reprisals and a limited ground offensive, but as the Iraqi offensive widened, its aims expanded to removing the Axis military mission, ending the threat to Kuwait, restoring British influence, and forcing the pro-German government from power.
impact: 這場戰爭迫使拉希德·阿里內閣倒台，費薩爾二世繼續在位，努里·賽義德於停戰後重新組閣；英軍則保留在巴格達、哈巴尼亞及其他交通據點的駐軍，逐步恢復對伊拉克軍隊、空軍基地與通訊設施的控制。德國與義大利在伊拉克的顧問團及航空任務被清除，親德軍官受到整肅，但英國影響的恢復並未消除伊拉克政界對外來控制的反感，這些矛盾在同年夏末的政變及英軍再度干預中重新顯現。軍事上，戰役顯示遠征攻勢必須把皇家空軍的偵察與近地支援、裝甲機動、道路補給及縱隊推進連成一體；阿拉伯軍團在北方戰線的作用也得到確認。戰後英國於1943年迫使伊拉克簽訂新條約，駐軍與軍事合作因而制度化。各軍戰報對作戰傷亡的統計口徑並不一致，沒有可靠的單一總數可供採用，因此這份實錄不列未經核實的精確傷亡數字。
impactEn: The war forced Rashid Ali's government from power, left Faisal II on the throne, and brought Nuri al-Said back to form a new cabinet. British troops remained at Baghdad, Habbaniya, and other communications centres, progressively restoring British control over the Iraqi army, air bases, and communications facilities. German and Italian military missions were removed from Iraq and pro-German officers were purged, but the restoration of British influence did not erase Iraqi political resentment toward external control; those tensions reappeared in a coup and renewed British intervention later in the same summer. Militarily, the campaign showed that a distant offensive had to connect aerial reconnaissance and close support, armored movement, road transport, and echeloned advance. It also confirmed the operational value of the Arab Legion on the northern front. After the war, Britain used the changed balance to secure a new Iraqi treaty in 1943, institutionalizing its garrison and military cooperation. The surviving reports use inconsistent definitions and coverage for combat losses, so no reliable single total can be used; this account therefore avoids presenting an unverified precise casualty figure.
result: 六月二日簽訂的停戰安排要求伊拉克部隊返回營區、停止對科威特及其他方向的進攻，並由英方接收或封存軸心國留在伊拉克的軍械與航空設備。拉希德·阿里內閣辭職，相關軍政人員先撤往伊朗方向，英軍則控制哈巴尼亞機場、巴格達及通往北部的主要道路。英國承認費薩爾二世與努里重新組成的新政府，伊拉克軍隊退出科威特，英軍則以修復秩序及維持作戰供應為由繼續留駐。結局是英軍取得伊拉克中部、北部交通線與主要空軍基地的控制，伊拉克親德政府垮台，而英國在伊拉克的長期軍事與政治影響獲得新的制度基礎。
resultEn: The ceasefire signed on 2 June required Iraqi troops to return to their barracks, end their attacks towards Kuwait and other directions, and surrender or place under British control the Axis weapons and aircraft equipment remaining in Iraq. Rashid Ali's government resigned, with its military and political personnel withdrawing towards Iran in the first instance, while the British took control of Habbaniya airfield, Baghdad, and the principal roads leading north. Britain recognized Faisal II and the new government formed by Nuri al-Said. Iraqi forces withdrew from Kuwait, and British troops remained in Iraq to restore order and sustain its fighting supplies. The outcome gave Britain control of central and northern Iraq's communications routes and principal air bases, brought down the pro-German Iraqi government, and established a new institutional basis for Britain's long-term military and political influence in Iraq.
